About Us

Lavish Luxe Nails & Spa opened its doors in May 2026, bringing a brand-new luxury nail studio to Surrey. Inside, you’ll find blush-and-gold interiors, plush pedicure chairs and a wall of polishes ready for your next look.

From regular, shellac and deluxe manicures and pedicures to nail extensions, kids’ nails, waxing and eyelash extensions, everything we do is about helping you leave feeling polished and pampered.

Clients have rated us 4.6 stars from 20 verified client ratings — come see why. And join 7,000+ followers on Instagram at @lavishluxenails.spa for our latest work.
